actions.newRateNote: The rate applies to sales from the date on; earlier bills keep theirs.

actions.packsNote: Each pack is its own SKU with its own price and stock. The cheapest active pack is the default.

actions.recordMovementNote: Purchases, returns and damage are counted as given; an adjustment can be negative.
actions.kitFromPujaNote: Fills a kit with each samagri the puja lists, at its default pack. Samagri the shop does not sell are skipped.
actions.newKitSetNote: One name and one set of photos for a puja's Basic, Standard and Premium kits. Each starts with the puja's samagri; open each kit's items to choose better grades.
actions.setMade: Basic, Standard and Premium kits made
actions.editSetNote: The name, photos, description and discount below change in all three packages of this puja.
actions.itemsNote: The packs in the kit and how many of each. Optional ones are left out unless the shopper adds them.
actions.samagriListNote: What this puja needs, how much and how strictly. Editing a line sends it back to unverified.
actions.verifyNote: Reviewed means checked by staff against a source; verified means confirmed by a guru or pandit.
actions.datesNote: One entry per year: lunar dates are entered here, never worked out.
actions.festivalPujasNote: The pujas the festival page offers, with their kits.
actions.publishNote: Only published articles show on the website; the first publish sets its date.
actions.uploadProductsNote: Use the downloaded list or the layout: a Products sheet and a Packs sheet. Rows match by code and SKU; new ones are added, a blank cell keeps what is saved. Prices are as sold, VAT included.
actions.uploadStockNote: A Movements sheet: sku, type (PURCHASE, RETURN, DAMAGE or ADJUSTMENT), quantity, and optionally unit_cost, reference and note. All rows are recorded together or none are.
actions.branchesNote: Admins see every branch whatever is set here.
actions.sendToBranchNote: Leaves this branch and arrives at the other at its average cost.
actions.addItemNote: Fill what you know; codes are made from the English name when left empty. Opening stock is added to the branch chosen at the top.
actions.addManyItemsNote: One item per row: name, how much is in one pack (amount and unit) and the price are enough. Turn on more columns (category, opening stock, cost, HS code, tags) above the grid. Opening stock goes to the branch chosen at the top; empty rows are skipped.

actions.archive: Archive (keep it, take it out of use)
actions.packKitsNote: The items of one kit come off this branch’s shelf for each kit you make. The packed kits are then sold from their own count, whatever happens to the items.

actions.uploadItemListNote: Download the list first (Download the layout). Each sheet is a category; grey rows are already in the shop and stay locked. Write new items in the empty rows under them: Nepali name, English name, search group and variants (50 gm, 1 kg, 5 पिस). Rule A: weights and counts of one thing are its variants. Rule B: a different size (सानो/मझौला/ठूलो) or quality (साधारण/स्पेसल) is its own row. A new sheet makes a new category. New items come in off sale until you set a selling price.

help.details: Item ko naam, tax, tags, barnan ra website ma dekhine kura. Badalepachhi tala Save thichnus. Photo ra price yaha chhaina: tinko alag tab chha.
help.packs: Yaha harek pack (jastai Seto · 120 cm · Premium) ko aafnai price lekhnus ra tala Save thichnus. Euta rang/size/quality ko sabai pack ma ek price halna mathi ko "Same price for" prayog garnus. Stock chai Stock screen ma.
help.options: Item rang, size, tauls jastai kura ma farak chha bhane tick garnus ra "Make packs" thichnus: sabai combination ek patak ma banchha. Rang/size ko value Colours and sizes ma banaunus.
help.photos: Item ka sabai photo ek thau ma. Pahilo photo mukhya hunchha. Photo kunai rang/size ko matra ho bhane "Shown for" ma tyo chunnus: customer le tyo rang chhanda tyahi photo dekhincha.
help.offers: Yo item ma kun-kun offer lagne bhanera tick garnus. Offer banauna Marketing → Offers ma jaanus. Tala pack anusar aajako price dekhincha.
help.quality: Item ko quality (sadharan, bishesh). Pack le tyo chhanchha. Nabhaye chhodidinus.
help.pairs: Yo item sanga kina jane aru item: product page ra cart ma "yo pani kinnus" bhanera dekhincha.

itemWorkspace.morePacks: More: add one pack by hand, change SKU or pack size, switch a pack off or delete it

itemPhotos.note: Photo upload garnus. Pahilo photo mukhya (card ra page ma). Kunai photo ek rang/size ko matra bhaye "Shown for" ma chunnus.
itemPhotos.none: No photos yet. Add one so customers can see the item.
itemPhotos.altMissing: Alt text khali. Photo ma ke dekhinchha lekhnus (jastai "Rato kapada, 1.5 m"). Khali bhae item ko naam jancha.

priceGrid.note: Harek pack ko price alag-alag halna milchha: Price (customer le tirne) ra MRP (chhapieko/purano price). Cost ra Margin kharid bill bata aafai aauchha; Margin = price (VAT bahek) ma cost ghatera. Jastai Seto 500, Kalo 450, Premium quality 500, Regular 400. Thok pack (jastai 25 kg bora) kharid ra repack ko lagi matra ho bhane "Sold to customers" untick garnus; tyo website/counter ma dekhidaina, tara stock ma rahancha.
priceGrid.forAll: Same price for all packs with

itemPage.notFound: This item could not be found.
itemPage.newNote: Naam, kasari bikchha, pahilo pack ra price halnus. Save garepachhi item ko page khulchha, jaha rang/size, photo ra offer halna milchha.

help.basics: Item ko naam, kasari bikchha (ek-ek, tauls, lambai, size), tax, tags ra barnan. Badalepachhi tala Save thichnus.
help.packs: Item kun-kun rang, size, lambai, tauls ma aaucha tick garera pack banaunus. "How it is sold" anusar milne option mathi aaucha.
help.prices: Harek pack ko bikri price ra MRP (chhapieko/purano price) yahi halnus. Cost ra margin aafai dekhincha: cost chai kharid bata aauchha.
help.photos: Item ka sabai photo ek thau ma. Pahilo mukhya. Kunai photo ek rang/size ko matra bhaye "Shown for" chunnus.
help.buying: Yo item kata bata, kati ma kinyo tyo yaha lekhnus. "Save and add to stock" garepachhi stock badhchha ra cost aafai set huncha.
help.offers: Yo item ma kun-kun offer lagne tick garnus. Naya offer Marketing → Offers ma.
help.more: Quality (sadharan, bishesh) ra yo item sanga kina jane aru item.

itemPage.stockNote: Stock harek pack ko Stock screen ma herne ra milaune. Maal kinera ayepachhi Buying ma bill banaunus, tyo bata stock ra cost aafai aauchha. MRP chai mathi Prices and cost ma.
itemPage.qualityNote: Item ko quality (sadharan, bishesh). Pack le tyo chhanchha. Nabhaye chhodidinus.
itemPage.goesWithNote: Yo item sanga kina jane aru item: product page ra cart ma "yo pani kinnus" bhanera dekhincha.

itemPage.makePacksFirst: Pahile Colours and sizes ma pack banaunus.

itemPage.buyBigger: I buy it in a bigger pack (a bag, a roll)

itemPage.bareNote: Item ko naam, kasari bikchha (ek-ek, tauls, lambai) ra category matra. Pack, size, rang ra rate kharid garda halne.
itemPage.bareNext: Aba bazar bata kinera ayepachhi Buy screen ma pack, size, rang ra rate halnus.
itemPage.sameName: Yo item ko naam arko item sanga milchha, tara yo alag item ho (naam milecha bhane matra tick garnus).
itemPage.similarNote: Yesto naam bhayeko item pahile nai chha bhane naya nabanaunus. Ek item ek patak matra; stock matra badhne-ghatne.
itemPage.similarSameWarn: Yo naam pahile nai chha. Tala ko item nai ho bhane Buy ma gayera stock thapnus.

kitPage.itemsNote: Pack chunnus ra kati ota. "Optional" tick bhaye kit ko price ma jodinna; add-on ko roop ma dekhincha.

flow.title: Bring something into the shop

hint.item: Pahila item ko naam matra halnus. Pack, size, rang ra rate kharid garda (step 2) halne.

hint.prices: Kharid bhayeko pack ko bechne price halera "On sale" garnus. Kharid ko rate yahi dekhincha.
hint.work: Stock ko kam: thok kholera chhoto pack banaune (repack), kharab/expire/harayo, gunera milaune, arko branch ma pathaune.

buyPage.title: Buy: record what you brought
buyPage.note: Bazar bata kinera ayepachhi yaha lekhnus. Kasbata, ke ke, kati ota ra kati ma kinyo. Bechne price pachhi (step 3).
buyPage.supplierHelp: Kun supplier/dokan bata kinyo. Naya hunuhunchha bhane pahile Suppliers ma banaunus.
buyPage.billNoHelp: Supplier ko bill ma bhayeko number. Bill chhaina bhane aajako mithi lekhnus (jastai 2083-07-30).
buyPage.itemHelp: Item pahile Step 1 ma naam le banaunus.
buyPage.packHelp: Pahile nai banieko pack chunnus, ya "A new pack" chunera yahi banaunus.
buyPage.amountHelp: Ek pack ma kati: bora 25 kg ho bhane 25000 (g), packet 100 g ho bhane 100.
buyPage.optionsHelp: Rang, size, quality chunnus (optional). Jastai Black.
buyPage.rateHelp: Ek pack ko kati ma kinyo (VAT bahek).
buyPage.needPack: Pratyek item ma item ra pack chunnus.
buyPage.needNewPack: Naya pack ma amount ra unit (ya colour/size) halnus.
buyPage.needRate: Pratyek item ma kati ota ra kati ma kinyo halnus.
buyPage.ready: Tayar chha. Save and add to stock garepachhi selling price halne page khulchha.
buyPage.postedMsg: Stock ma add bhayo. Aba selling price halnus.
buyPage.noPacksYet: Yo item ko pack pahile banieko chhaina. Amount ra unit lekhera banaunus.
buyPage.packNameHelp: Khali rakhnus: amount ra unit bata aafai banchha. Bora/baksa jasto naam chahiyo bhane lekhnus.

buy.savedNeedPrice: Saved and in stock. {n, plural, one {# line needs} other {# lines need}} a selling price.
